assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The service is Mobile cardiac telemetry with CPT code 93229.
The diagnosis codes G45.9 and I49.5 support medical necessity for this service under the member's benefit plan.
